subject.title: Feature: Built-in pace-aware rate limiting for autonomous agents

question: Should OpenClaw add core pace-aware provider usage controls for autonomous agents, and should the first phase be observability-only or include enforcement?
rationale: The remaining work would add provider-specific semantics, persisted usage state, new agent config, and autonomous throttling behavior, which cannot be safely chosen from source inspection alone.

options.title: Phase Observability First
options.body: Capture and expose pace context in status and session_status without blocking work until the data model and provider semantics prove reliable.

options.title: Add Opt-In Enforcement
options.body: Introduce disabled-by-default pace thresholds that can throttle subagents, with explicit config, tests, and operator recovery guidance.

options.title: Plugin/API First
options.body: Keep core lean by first designing provider and agent hooks so a plugin can own pace policy without hardcoding Anthropic behavior in core.

recommendation.title: Phase Observability First
recommendation.body: Capture and expose pace context in status and session_status without blocking work until the data model and provider semantics prove reliable.

likelyOwner.reason: The current provider usage/status surfaces that this feature would extend are most directly tied to steipete's recent area history.
